content.comment_body: While working with the attached [product_name] program, the simulation unexpectedly stopped responding. After exiting simulation mode, the power section stays red, and everything else remains blue. Is this due to a specific setting or a programming error? Has anyone else encountered this issue? Any input would be appreciated.

Hi, This is a known issue when using LAD (Ladder Diagram); there are some other problems too. If you convert your program to FBD (Function Block Diagram), simulation works correctly. Personally, I find FBD easier for simulation and monitoring in one view. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users have encountered simulation freezes in [product_name] software when programming with LAD. After the freeze, the power side stays visually active, while the rest of the program appears inactive. Switching to FBD format seems to prevent the issue, highlighting inconsistencies in simulation behavior across graphical programming modes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect consistent and reliable simulation regardless of the graphical programming mode chosen. They are seeking clarification on whether this issue stems from a setting or software bug, and want to hear from others who might have experienced similar problems.
